ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters comprising approximately 3-5% of the total visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white ring-shaped geometric blobs are clustered on the mid-distal left lobe and scattered across the central right lobe. High-intensity pixel flecks are concentrated along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle (~120-135 degrees) and minimal vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected across the entire trailing edge boundary. Right lobe margin displays significantly higher pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature transitioning to tapered, posteriorly-hooked distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast circular and ovoid white ring clusters. Primary constellation of ~6 rings is visible on the left lobe; secondary scattered rings are located in the central and lateral regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the medial-right lobe, appearing as thin unaligned scratches against the dark base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (consistent with parasitic/barnacle attachment) across both lobes; secondary mechanical trauma visible as deep, irregular notches on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive sequence of jagged, saw-tooth peaks on the upper-right trailing edge, creating a uniquely irregular contour compared to the left lobe.
